source_snapshot.procedure: Run `mlxlink -d <device name> -p 1 -c` for physical link/speed/bandwidth/FW and `mlxlink -d <device name> --port_type PCIE -c` for PCIe counters/bandwidth.
source_snapshot.criteria: Tools install and terminal shows correct information.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES but substitutes lspci/mst/ibstat and truncates output.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Restores both mlxlink views but leaves device mapping and expected negotiated values as project inputs.

old_problem: Prior review held the case Pending because exact NIC/port/peer mapping, tool version, expected link negotiation, firmware and counter thresholds were not populated.
disposition_reason: ED-05 keeps Ethernet and InfiniBand identity distinct, while ED-15 prevents a verdict without approved expectations. Those values are execution-time project configuration, not missing command semantics: mlxlink has explicit read-only physical and PCIe views. A complete parameterized test therefore resolves the review decision while requiring the versioned topology/recipe before execution.
decision_basis: Read XLSX row150, same-row AI fields and history2536; unique identity confirmed.
Restored both literal mlxlink commands as primary coverage; lspci/mst/ibstat remain supporting identity evidence.
Parameterized NIC/BDF/mlxlink/port/peer and protocol-specific expected values instead of guessing them.
Defined cumulative-counter baseline/delta handling, complete untruncated evidence and no link mutation; no DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: Parameterized Mellanox physical-port and PCIe link information check
test_case.purpose: For each approved Mellanox NIC/port, verify physical-link and PCIe-side negotiated state, firmware and counters against a versioned project recipe.
required_package: Compatible pinned OFED/MFT/mst/mlxlink and supporting lspci/ibstat tools
Runtime NIC PN/serial/BDF/netdev/RDMA/mlxlink-device and port1 peer/cable map
Project recipe for Ethernet or InfiniBand mode, link state, speed/lanes, PCIe generation/width/bandwidth and firmware
Counter names/units, initial baseline, observation window and allowed deltas
Secure target access and approved package-install policy
test_case.test_command: Resolve the immutable NIC/port mapping, capture full tool/version and lspci/mst/ibstat identity evidence, then run complete `mlxlink -d <verified-device> -p 1 -c` and `mlxlink -d <verified-device> --port_type PCIE -c`; compare every configured field and counter delta without reset, link toggle or output truncation.
test_case.expected_result: Both views identify the same approved NIC; physical mode/link/speed/lanes and PCIe generation/width/bandwidth/firmware equal the project recipe, configured counters stay within allowed baseline/delta limits, and no new driver/kernel link error appears.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS is computed only after loading the signed project recipe: all required identities and fields match and every configured counter delta is within limit. Wrong/missing port, down/degraded negotiation, firmware mismatch, counter excess, incomplete output or new link error fails; absent recipe blocks execution but no longer leaves the review decision Pending.
safety_gate: Verify device/port/peer identity; never guess `<device name>` or connector mapping.
Use read-only `-c` information/counter paths only; no reset/configuration/firmware action.
Capture complete output and tool versions; no `head`/`tail` truncation.
Stop on mapping ambiguity, link flap or disappearing device; do not retry automatically.
expected_evidence: Expected-versus-observed negotiation/firmware/counter-delta matrix, relevant logs and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Read-only collection requires no state recovery. On unexpected link change or tool side effect, preserve evidence, stop, and use the owner-approved network recovery; never toggle/reset automatically.

source_conflict.reason: Source commands consistently request two Mellanox observation planes; fallback substitution was corrected without changing source intent.

blocked.reason: Standard tool semantics are known and all project-specific values are explicit runtime prerequisites.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: At execution, bind NIC/port/peer identities, tool versions, protocol-specific negotiated expectations, firmware and counter-delta recipe.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW DECISION RESOLVED; EXECUTION REQUIRES CONFIGURATION/CONFIRMATION; NO DUT ACTION EXECUTED
pending.owner: Network/platform owner supplies the signed runtime topology and recipe; engineer owns verdict.
pending.unlock_condition: No further engineering-decision resolution is required; populate and approve the runtime manifest before collection.

project_authority: The installed NIC/peer topology and versioned project networking recipe control negotiated expectations; mlxlink provides the standard observation mechanism.
